subject: Renewal: Isolation & analytics cluster request — BioSync
messages:
From: Claire D'Souza <claire@biosync.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: BioSync Procurement <procurement@biosync.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Renewal notice + request for isolated analytics cluster and cold-airgap archive

Hi Sofia,

Our renewal for the Private deployment is coming up in Sept and we need to discuss a couple of additions before we sign: a dedicated isolated analytics cluster (EU region) for R&D workloads and an air-gapped cold archive for PHI-compliant overnight snapshots. Key asks: 
- Isolation: network-level tenancy (no cross-tenant KV cache) and separate control plane read-only view for our ops team.
- Latency SLO: analytics queries can tolerate higher p95 but inference endpoints must keep 95th <120ms.
- Term: we are open to moving to a 24-month commit if pricing and capacity guarantees align.

I've attached a short RFQ and our renewal worksheet. Can we schedule a technical + procurement sync this week?

Thanks,
Claire
Director, Cloud Platform
BioSync Therapeutics

[attachment: isolation-rfq.pdf (PDF)]
[attachment: renewal-worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Claire D'Souza <claire@biosync.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + request for isolated analytics cluster and cold-airgap archive

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear notes and the RFQ. We're able to support both asks but there are a few tradeoffs to cover:

- Isolation model: we can provision a physically isolated cluster (new tenant) in eu-west-1 and disable cross-tenant prefix caching for that tenant. This will remove KV cache sharing and reduce cost-efficiencies.
- Cold archive: set up as an air-gapped S3-compatible bucket with strict egress rules; we will provide tooling for scheduled snapshot uploads and verification.
- Latency: preserving 95th <120ms for inference will require reserving dedicated inference slots (Dedicated capacity) for peak windows — we'll propose a burst pool + prewarmed KV cache.
- Term & pricing: preliminary pricing delta attached; moving to 24 months lets us amortize the isolation setup and offer a 12% subscription discount.

I've looped in Karthik for the infra design and Monica for commercial/pricing. Can we do a 45-minute technical sync on Wed 13 Aug at 14:00 CEST? If procurement needs separate time, we can do a short follow-up.

Regards,
Sofia
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[attachment: proposed-pricing-delta.pdf (PDF)]

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:45:00 +02:00
Subject: Internal: BioSync — pricing/term options and checklist

Team — quick internal note before the sync with Claire:

1) Pricing: attach shows two options: (A) 24-month term with 12% discount but no rollback on reserved capacity for first 6 months; (B) 12-month term with 6% discount + option to add capacity at month 6 with surcharge.
2) Compliance: they asked for HSM-backed key storage for archive; need Security sign-off for HSM integration and audit evidence.
3) Capacity: propose 2x inference nodes (pinned), 1x analytics cluster with 4 GPUs (isolation), and a cold archive job runner (small VM pool).
4) Timeline: we can provision isolated cluster in ~6 weeks after contract signature if PO arrives on time. If they want cutover before renewal, recommend a temporary burst allocation.

Action items: Karthik to prepare infra diagram + latency mitigation notes; Marcus to produce a clear cost delta and monthly burn estimate; Sofia to confirm legal/PO path with Claire.

-Monica

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:22:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BioSync — pricing/term options and checklist

Monica / team — notes for the tech sync:

- Proposed infra: new VPC tenant (eu-west-1) + isolated _analytics_ cluster (no shared KV cache). We'll enable per-tenant cache keys and prewarm routine to reduce first-token latency for inference.
- Inference SLO: to hit p95 <120ms we need pinned inference slots with CPU fallback disabled and prefer optimized quantized model variant. Also recommend continuous batching window tuned to their qps distribution (we'll show simul results).
- HSM: integration is straightforward for archive keys; need legal for key escrow & access policy.
- Quiet windows: ask them for a daily 02:00-04:00 maintenance window for snapshot uploads (minimal impact).

I'll have a basic diagram for Wed's call.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Claire D'Souza <claire@biosync.com>, BioSync Procurement <procurement@biosync.com>

Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2026 14:49:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: Isolation & analytics cluster request — BioSync (proposed next steps)

Hi Claire — great sync earlier, thanks everyone. Summary and next steps below: 

Summary of agreed plan:
- Provision an isolated analytics cluster in eu-west-1 (4x A100-equivalent GPUs) and a dedicated inference pool with 2 pinned nodes to preserve p95 <120ms.
- Set up an air-gapped, HSM-keyed cold archive with scheduled uploads at 02:00-03:00 CET (your ops agreed to the quiet window).
- Term: default to a 24-month committed term to unlock the 12% discount; we'll include a 6-month stability clause for reserved capacity.
- Timeline: 6 weeks from PO receipt for analytics cluster provisioning; archive and HSM config can be completed in parallel (4 weeks).

Commercials & ask:
- Attached is the formal pricing delta and a draft PO template. We estimate an incremental monthly burn of €17,500 for the isolated infra (line items in the attached).
- Please confirm approval path for the PO and target sign date — if we receive PO by 2026-08-24 we can begin provisioning and aim for a 2026-10-05 cutover.

Next steps:
1) BioSync to confirm PO approver and send PO to procurement@redwood.ai.
2) Redwood to provide final infra diagram and onboarding runbook (Karthik).
3) Legal to review HSM/key escrow language (Sofia will loop legal if needed).

Appreciate the quick responses — happy to jump back on a call if procurement prefers to walk through the PO.

Best,
Sofia
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
